title: SIH26092 KB shared definitions
description: Shared shapes used across canonical KB entity schemas.

id.description: Stable canonical identifier unique within its entity.

source_ref.description: Zero or more Source ids (see sources.json). Empty means no document-level source is attached.

derived_marker.description: true = this value/field is DERIVED (computed or interpreted), not directly stated in a source.

availability.description: AVAILABLE=source states it; PARTIAL=weaker form stated; MISSING=no source provides it (null, do not guess); NOT_SPECIFIED=source is silent (distinct from explicit absence); UNKNOWN=existence uncertain.

scalar_or_conditional.description: A scalar (number | integer | string) or an explicit conditional object or formula object.

oneOf.description: Formula object, e.g. ELS loan cap: min(40L, 90% of course fee).
